collection.description: A child wonders whether the spirits are simply the kindness people show one another.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A child wonders whether the spirits are simply the kindness people show one another.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Villagers begin speaking of generosity as a sacred act.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: Some insist that spirits, if real, must be more than a metaphor.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The child invents a playful ceremony celebrating human creativity.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: An elder objects that the village cannot prove people are divine.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The child keeps asking thoughtful questions.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A healer says uncertainty need not prevent kindness.
